name: Aztec Fluids & Machinery Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, Aztec Fluids & Machinery Ltd manufactures printers and trades inks[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
AFML is a provider of coding and marking solutions in India. It specializes in offering equipment for printing variable information on products and packaging materials. It also provides printers, printer consumables, and spares for diverse industries.

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 116%
cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.82 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 68.4 to 88.9 days.
